source: Sandbox landmarks, not a course or IALA navigation marks. Positions are world x (east) and z (south) in metres, named by their bearing from Westcove Harbour's departure (-1740, 760) and set 0.65-1.1 km out in 10-21 m of water, at least 6.9 m deep everywhere within 150 m: N up the west shore (upwind for the default wind from the north), NE off the south side of Great Holm, E out across the bay, SE and S on the way to Westcove's south shore. VISUAL ESTIMATE sizes, distinctive colours/topmarks and painted IDs for milestone 6 sighting and chart identification.
